entries.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished art direction concept board for a personal command-center dashboard themed around the Two Trees of Valinor and the High Elves. Landscape 16:9. This is a design artwork proposal, not a functioning UI. Show one cohesive beautiful dashboard composition with a left navigation column, a wide cinematic header, and three neatly proportioned framed content cards. Two great luminous trees form the header's central emblem: one silver-white glowing tree and one warm golden glowing tree, their branches gently intertwining but retaining distinct light. Distant ethereal High Elven white marble terraces, slender graceful architecture, tranquil water, luminous gardens beneath blue-violet twilight. Visual design: exquisitely fine silver and pale champagne gold metal frames with flowing organic leaf and star tracery, ivory stone accents, subtle moonstone cabochons; midnight indigo translucent panel interiors with readable pale ivory typography. Restrained radiant edges, premium realistic hand-crafted fantasy game interface, crisp and elegant, not heavy armor, not rustic wood, not dwarven, not Gondor heraldry, no White Tree shields or lion heads. The scenic world remains visible between the cards. Small dimensional visual icons: illuminated manuscript, round door, provisions basket, crossed elven blades, treasure casket, and star compass in the navigation. Main header text exactly 'THE TWO TREES'. Smaller subtitle exactly 'SAGE’S COMMAND CENTER'. Cards titled exactly 'The days ahead', 'Weather', 'The treasury', with a few quiet placeholder lines and simple visual symbols; avoid tiny illegible dense text. Include a narrow lower strip with five labeled color swatches 'Moon silver', 'Tree gold', 'Ivory', 'Twilight', 'Sage'. Render like a professional high-fantasy UI art director's presentation, cinematic realistic artwork, coherent materials, generous but compact readable composition, sophisticated rather than cluttered. No logos or watermarks.

Use the attached image only as an art-direction reference. Create a NEW standalone website HEADER BACKGROUND illustration, panoramic wide 3:1 aspect ratio. Theme: the Two Trees of Valinor and the High Elves. Two majestic luminous trees on the right half: silver-white Telperion and golden Laurelin, distinct silver and gold foliage with subtly intertwined roots, planted on an elegant raised white marble terrace. Background a tranquil lake, ethereal slender High Elven towers and gardens, distant mountain silhouettes, blue-violet twilight with delicate stars. Left half is quiet atmospheric deep indigo landscape and softly shadowed marble terrace, suitable for live HTML title and search controls overlaid later. Lower edge softly darker. Richly detailed cinematic matte painting, exquisite believable materials, pale silver and champagne gold ornament. Same elegant refined visual world as reference. NO text, NO typography, NO UI, NO cards, NO navigation, NO frames or border around the image, NO palette swatches, NO people, NO logos. Image must fill the entire rectangular canvas.

Use the attached image only as an art-direction reference. Create a NEW standalone full-page website BACKGROUND landscape illustration, wide 16:9. Theme: the realm of the Two Trees of Valinor and the High Elves. View from a white marble garden terrace over a tranquil reflecting lake toward an exquisite luminous High Elven city of slender ivory towers, arching bridges and terraced gardens among forested hills and distant mountains. On the far right skyline, two immense sacred trees, one softly glowing silver-white and one glowing warm gold, whose light spills gently across the water. Delicate flowering vines frame outer edges, white flowers, silver leaves, subtle gold lanterns. Rich blue-violet twilight with natural reflected silver and gold illumination, deep atmospheric perspective. Center must be calm, lower contrast and spacious so dashboard panels placed over it remain readable; fine detail concentrated around edges. Premium cinematic realistic fantasy matte painting matching the reference's elegant luminous materials. Full bleed. NO text, NO UI, NO boxes or panels, NO icons, NO border, NO logos, NO people. Avoid overly bright white center, heavy haze or oversaturated purple.

Use attached image as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a NEW standalone transparent PNG UI PANEL FRAME asset for a Two Trees of Valinor / High Elven dashboard. A complete rectangular landscape frame, 3:2 ratio, centered with clear margin outside all four sides, all four corners and all four connecting rails fully visible and joined. Both the entire center opening and the exterior must be genuinely transparent alpha, not black or colored and not a painted checkerboard. Frame only; no filled panel. Intricate but restrained polished moon-silver metal with champagne-gold leaf filigree and small ivory accents, slender organic branching contours, a pale translucent moonstone cabochon at the top center, tiny eight-point star at bottom center. Upper-left corner uses silver leaves, upper-right gold leaves, reflecting the Two Trees. Calm long straight parallel rails between distinctive corners, suitable for future nine-slice implementation. Corners rounded gently with leaves following the curve. Thin elegant frame, not thick armor. Highly detailed realistic collectible fantasy UI ornament matching reference. NO text, NO scenery, NO UI content, NO objects floating in the center, NO shields, NO lions, NO giant tree emblem, NO glowing haze beyond frame edges. A single border asset.

Edit the supplied PANEL FRAME asset. Preserve its exact silver and gold leaf ornament, moonstone gems, connected four rails and all four corners. Remove ALL the smoky brown/gray background haze around the rails, in the corners and behind the frame. Every pixel other than the solid physical metal, leaves and gemstones must be completely transparent alpha zero, including the whole large rectangular center opening and the whole exterior beyond the outline. NO background color, NO shadow cloud, NO vignette, NO glow, NO gradient, NO backdrop, NO checkerboard illustration. Only cleanly cut-out physical frame ornament on genuine transparent alpha. Keep full frame in view and leave transparent padding around it.

Use attached image as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate a NEW TRANSPARENT PNG SPRITE SHEET containing exactly twelve distinct small dimensional High Elven dashboard icons, evenly spaced in a precise four-column by three-row grid, each icon centered in its own equal square cell with generous transparent padding. No text or labels anywhere. All icons share elegant polished silver and champagne-gold leafwork with ivory and tiny moonstone details, softly lit realistic fantasy prop style, readable silhouette at small size. No filled icon tile, no circular badge background, genuinely transparent alpha between and behind icons. Top row left to right: 1 illuminated open calendar book with blank pages, 2 graceful round arched ivory-and-gold home door, 3 woven silver-gold provisions basket with bread and fruit, 4 silver raven carrying a sealed cream envelope. Middle row: 5 luminous crystal seeing orb in a delicate elven stand for AI, 6 rolled news scroll with blank parchment, 7 crossed fine silver quill and small artisan tool for Tools and Systems, 8 eight-point silver-gold star compass. Bottom row: 9 silver-and-gold leaf shaped sun-and-cloud weather icon, 10 small elegant crystal-lens camera, 11 delicate circular two-arrow refresh symbol made of silver and gold leaves, 12 ornate silver cog with golden leaf spokes for Settings. Keep each object separate without overlap, no clipping at cell boundaries, no treasure chest, no coins, no warcraft weapons or logos. No letters, numbers, decorative writing or watermark. Premium matching set intended to be cut into twelve icon assets later.

Use the attached concept board only as STYLE REFERENCE. Create one NEW standalone slim VERTICAL NAVIGATION DIVIDER ornament for a Two Trees of Valinor / High Elven dashboard, on genuine transparent alpha background. Tall narrow portrait asset with entire rail visible from top finial to bottom finial, centered and isolated with transparent margins. Elegant polished silver structural rail, a thin champagne-gold winding vine, small ivory leaves. Top finial features a small double-tree medallion: silver tree on left, gold tree on right, with a single pale moonstone teardrop below. Bottom finial tapers gracefully into a leaf-shaped point with a tiny eight-point star. Middle two-thirds is a quiet straight continuous slender shaft with subtle restrained vine engraving, suitable to extend vertically in a website. Premium realistic fantasy metalwork, elegant delicate High Elven design matching the concept, not rustic wood and not heavy armor. NO backdrop, NO gradient field, NO cast shadow cloud, NO text, NO border around canvas, NO UI. Absolutely transparent everywhere except the physical ornament.

Use attached concept board as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a NEW transparent PNG UI BUTTON ASSET ATLAS for a Two Trees of Valinor / High Elven dashboard. Exactly six EMPTY horizontal button plates, arranged in three columns by two rows, every plate entirely separate with generous genuine transparent alpha padding and no overlap. Equal button sizes, approximately 4:1 width-to-height ratio. Top row shows primary button normal, hover, pressed. Bottom row shows secondary button normal, hover, disabled. These are blank art assets; no labels, no letters, no symbols in button centers. All buttons have restrained polished silver and champagne-gold leaf filigree outlines, tiny moonstone corners, shallow curved elven corners, slender rails and deep twilight-indigo filled inset faces intended to receive live HTML text later. Normal primary is midnight blue with silver-gold rim, hover has gentle brighter pale gold inner edge and slightly lighter blue face, pressed has darker indigo face and inset rim. Secondary normal has charcoal blue face and mostly silver rim, secondary hover brighter silver rim, disabled desaturated slate and reduced ornament contrast. Beautiful realistic fantasy game UI, small and tasteful organic leaf corners. No background outside buttons, no smoky haze between buttons, no full sheet frame, no title or watermark. Center all plates in precise equal cells.

Edit the attached dashboard CONCEPT BOARD only. Preserve the gorgeous Two Trees of Valinor header, the silver tree and golden tree, twilight lake and High Elven city, elegant silver/champagne-gold/ivory leaf frames, exact overall composition and color swatch strip. This concept board should illustrate ONLY the dashboard sections being redesigned. Change the right content card from 'The treasury' to exactly 'Tools & Systems'; remove its treasure chest and finance/savings/progress content, replace those with a beautiful silver quill and scroll desk vignette and three compact small icon tiles (a star compass, a crystal orb, an artisan quill) and a button labeled exactly 'Add Link'. Left navigation should contain exactly these six clearly readable labels in order: 'Overview', 'Bag End', 'Provisions', 'The Ravens', 'Tools', 'Settings'. Match icons respectively open calendar book, elegant ivory arched door, provisions basket, silver raven with letter, quill and artisan tool, silver-gold cog. No treasury or coin icons, no combat/weapon icons in this image. Keep the center Weather card and left days ahead card as-is. Main header still reads 'THE TWO TREES' and 'SAGE’S COMMAND CENTER'. This is a concept artwork illustration, not live dashboard data. Premium coherent game UI art, no additional headings or labels.
